title: Design Associate
jobDescription: About Homelane HomeLane is built for designers who want more-more growth, more ownership, more earning potential, and more impact. We back designers with structured career acceleration, industry-leading rewards, real ownership of outcomes, and a growth ecosystem that evolves with you-from your first project to leading teams or launching your own studio. If you’re looking for a place where your creativity compounds into capability, credibility, and income - this is it. Design Associate Company: HomeLane Experience: 0-1 Year Industry: Interior Design / Residential Projects Role Overview We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Interior Design Associate to support our Senior Designers in delivering high-quality residential interior projects. This is an excellent opportunity for freshers or early-career designers to gain hands-on exposure to client discussions, 3D designing, site coordination, and project execution within a fast-paced, professional environment. The role demands creativity, willingness to learn, strong coordination skills, and a proactive attitude. Key Responsibilities ● Shadow Senior Designers during client meetings and design discussions. ● Prepare accurate Minutes of Meetings (MoM) and track project milestones to ensure timely execution. ● Assist in creating 3D designs using SpaceCraft (HomeLane’s internal software) and SketchUp. ● Support in developing commercial proposals and validating quotations for accuracy and transparency. ● Participate in site visits and assist in site measurements and masking activities. ● Maintain organized project documentation across HomeLane tech systems. ● Coordinate with internal teams such as Sales, Drawing QC, Project Management, and Planners to ensure smooth project flow. ● Provide design inputs and suggest enhancements under the guidance of the Senior Designer. Mandatory Qualifications ● Bachelor’s Degree / Diploma in Architecture or Design (B.Arch, B.Des, M.Des, or Diploma in Design). ● 0-1 year of experience in Interior Design or Architecture (freshers are welcome to apply). ● Basic knowledge of modular furniture and residential interior concepts. ● Working knowledge of SketchUp (mandatory). ● Good communication and presentation skills. ● Strong attention to detail and willingness to learn. ● A proactive attitude with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

title: Design Manager
jobDescription: Design Manager | Lead Interior Design Teams Are you a design leader who thrives on driving performance, mentoring teams, and delivering exceptional customer experiences? We’re looking for a Design Manager to lead a team of designers at our showroom. This is a high-impact leadership role where design excellence meets revenue ownership, requiring strong team leadership, customer management, and project funnel oversight to ensure predictable business outcomes.

title: Senior design consultant
jobDescription: We are looking for a creative and customer-focused Interior Design Consultant to manage residential design projects at HomeLane. In this role, you will work closely with customers from the first consultation to design finalization and order booking, delivering functional, aesthetic, and budget-aligned solutions. This position requires strong design fundamentals, working knowledge of site execution, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple customers while ensuring a smooth and delightful experience.

title: Senior Executive - Relationship Management
jobDescription: Prospect relentlessly to build pipeline and build strong relationships with prospects •Own the experience we give every prospective customer from the first time they interact with us •Be responsible for achieving sales targets by working with a talented group of interiors designers •Be proactive about solving problems even if it's outside of your area and be ready to take on additional initiatives and responsibilities as they emerge •World-class customer experience is what we pride ourselves on. Hence, we will expect you to share our passion and commitment for serving customers •The ideal candidate for this role will come with past experience in managing relationships with customers and running a sales team, with clear sales targets •We are a fast-growing startup (15000+ projects completed) and expect all our colleagues to be flexible, action and results oriented self-starters with strong data analysis skills. •We are heavily biased towards candidates who come with a proven track record of taking ownership, understanding customer pain-points, driving results and moving with speed to implement ideas in a fast-paced environment. •Lastly, we are looking for effective communicators who can work effortlessly with customers, colleagues, business partners and vendors, alike •Lead alternate channel of Sales - Residence visits, design/sales at show flats, apartment activities •Open to new initiatives EXPERTISE AND QUALIFICATIONS What are we looking for? •Excellent verbal and written communications skills • • 1-5 years of experience in Sales Strong listening and presentation skills •Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively
